quoted_requirements: 保护数量：跟随本次主单数量。按本单基础币数量构造退出单。确认页标明本次保护数量。
默认盈亏金额（PnL），标记价格（Mark）；各腿独立选择输入模式与触发依据。

sources.formula_excerpt:
盈亏换算（线性合约）　设 E 为预计开仓价，Q 为基础币数量，L 为杠杆，方向系数 d 开多取 +1、开空取 −1。按目标盈亏金额 P 换算的价格为 E＋d×P÷Q，止损 P 取负数。按目标 ROI 换算的价格为 E×(1＋d×ROI÷L)，例如 5% 代入 0.05。手填退出限价时，盈亏预览按预计执行价计算，触发仍比较触发价。以上为下单前毛盈亏估算，实际盈亏取决于成交价、成交量及费用。 示例　假设预计以 100 USDT 买入 2 枚，杠杆 5×。保持默认 PnL 输入，止盈填 +10 USDT，止损填 −4 USDT。预览显示「Mark ≥ 105 USDT，市价卖出」及「Mark ≤ 98 USDT，市价卖出」。对应预计 ROI 为 +25% 和 −10%。若将止损改为手动限价 97.5，仍在 Mark ≤ 98 时触发，随后挂出价格为 97.5 的卖单。 3　确认、成交与失败处理

sources.contract: placeStrategyOrder documents STOP / TAKE_PROFIT with positive price and stopPrice, market variants, workingType, optional stop-order timeInForce default GTC, and PARTIALLY_FILLED_OR_FILLED driving events.

observations: firstDrivenOn and secondDrivenOn PARTIALLY_FILLED_OR_FILLED; PLACE_ORDER and CANCEL_ORDER respectively.
Manual or auto limit exits use TAKE_PROFIT / STOP; market variants otherwise; website uses GTE_GTC.
sources.boundary: Vanta sends documented GTC for limit exits; it does not assert website-internal GTE_GTC support in public V3.

implementation.quantity: New OrderQuery.capture stores exact main-order quantity. estimatedOpeningQuantity remains unchanged for incremental margin; it is not an exit quantity source.
implementation.input_modes: PnL default; separate PnL / trigger price / ROI controllers for each leg. Positive TP and negative SL for PnL / ROI; price inputs positive. Disabled protection and advanced settings retain raw inputs but do not submit dormant terms.
implementation.entry_reference: Ordinary limit uses entered entry price; ordinary market uses buy ask / sell bid. Conditional market uses main trigger. BBO uses indicative mark / trigger and delegates bracket direction to exchange. Missing needed quote shows unavailable; no silent replacement basis.
implementation.arithmetic: Decimal and Rational only. PnL trigger E+d*P/Q. ROI percent trigger E*(1+d*ROIpercent/(100*L)). Derived triggers rounded once to nearest PRICE_FILTER tick relative to minPrice, then validated. Entered trigger and limit prices are never rounded.
implementation.preview: Gross PnL uses manual exit limit if selected; otherwise trigger reference. Gross margin ROI excludes fees/slippage and is rounded to 8dp only for display if repeating.
implementation.execution: Per leg MARKET / manual LIMIT / auto LIMIT. Auto limit price equals aligned trigger. Exit legs retain STOP / TAKE_PROFIT original type, GTC, workingType, reduceOnly in one-way mode and original LONG/SHORT without reduceOnly in hedge mode.
implementation.linkage: New strategies use PARTIALLY_FILLED_OR_FILLED for entry PLACE_ORDER and peer CANCEL_ORDER. Query verifies exact fields before resolving; activation and fills are not inferred from request.
implementation.journal: Schema4 uses same canonical pending-futures-orders-v1.json filename, reads versions1-4, retains old protectedQuantity and FILLED rules, adds exact execution mode / limit price / drivenOn. Schema1-3 reject modern fields; malformed data fails closed.
implementation.signing: Existing connected EOA / existing Privy wallet signs as user=signer. No wallet creation, automatic signatures, POST retry or funds mutation during verification.

remaining: Strategy and leg statuses are displayed from the signed strategy query; actual per-leg executed quantities / execution amounts and a complete strategy management list are not yet implemented.
Actual partial-fill activation, quantity replenishment and peer cancellation need exchange reports and authenticated acceptance testing; none performed.
Real same-EOA API signer acceptance, native layouts / wallet roundtrips / process storage recovery and iOS remain pending per user.
Full PRD remains incomplete: Futures history, complete Portfolio, Swap and other tracked gaps; only explicitly deferred BAPI statistics / Summary / TWAP are skipped.
